claim: In the uniform random-codebook additive-noise model with codebook size \(M_n=2^{\lfloor nR\rfloor}\), rate \(R\in(0,1)\), and noise patterns ordered by nonincreasing likelihood, the fixed-list rank-conditioned reliability theorem extends to every list length \(L_n\) satisfying \(2\le L_n<M_n\) and \(\log_2 L_n=o(n)\). Assume the guesswork large-deviation and point-rank limits used in the fixed-list theorem hold at the relevant rank exponents, with \(n^{-1}\log_2 q_{1,n}\to y_1\), \(n^{-1}\log_2 q_{2,n}\to y_2\), and \(n^{-1}\log_2 q_{L_n,n}\to y_L<1\). Writing \(I\) for the guesswork rate function and \(g(y)=I(y)+y\), define \[\Delta=\min\left\{g(y_2),\,1-R+\inf_{x\ge y_L}I(x)\right\}-g(y_1).\] Whenever \(\Delta\ne0\), the posterior probability \(S_n\) that the first list entry is the transmitted codeword satisfies: if \(\Delta>0\), then \(S_n\to1\) and \(-n^{-1}\log_2(1-S_n)\to\Delta\); if \(\Delta<0\), then \(S_n\to0\) and \(-n^{-1}\log_2 S_n\to-\Delta\). No conclusion is asserted at the boundary \(\Delta=0\).

integrity.computational_claims: No numerical computation or finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact random-codebook posterior formula and exponential-rate comparison.

scientific_limitations: Requires the point-rank and tail large-deviation limits assumed in the fixed-list framework.
Applies to a uniform random-codebook additive-noise model, with subexponential list size and last-rank exponent below one.
No conclusion at Delta=0 or for exponentially growing lists; arbitrary fixed codebooks are not covered.
title: Subexponential-list stability of rank-conditioned decoding reliability
